import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static final int MAXM = 65536;
    static final int MAX = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000007;
    static final int CELLQ = MAX * MAX + 5;

    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static class Network {
        int n, m, s, t;
        ArrayList<Edge>[] e;
        int[] cnt, d, done, path;
        int len;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        void init(int n_, int s_, int t_) {
            n = n_;
            m = 0;
            s = s_;
            t = t_;
            e = new ArrayList[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) e[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            cnt = new int[n];
            d = new int[n];
            done = new int[n];
            path = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int a, int b, int cap) {
            e[a].add(new Edge(b, e[b].size(), cap));
            e[b].add(new Edge(a, e[a].size() - 1, 0));
            m += 2;
        }

        void bfs() {
            int[] q = new int[n];
            int head = 0, tail = 0;
            Arrays.fill(cnt, 0);
            Arrays.fill(d, n);
            d[t] = 0;
            q[tail++] = t;
            while (head < tail) {
                int u = q[head++];
                ++cnt[d[u]];
                for (Edge edge : e[u]) {
                    if (d[edge.to] == n && e[edge.to].get(edge.rev).cap > 0) {
                        d[edge.to] = d[u] + 1;
                        q[tail++] = edge.to;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        void retreat(int u) {
            --cnt[d[u]];
            d[u] = n;
            for (int i = 0; i < e[u].size(); ++i) {
                Edge arc = e[u].get(i);
                if (d[u] > d[arc.to] + 1 && arc.cap > 0) {
                    d[u] = d[arc.to] + 1;
                    done[u] = i;
                }
            }
            ++cnt[d[u]];
        }

        int augment() {
            int add = 0x7fffff;
            int cut = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
                Edge arc = e[path[i]].get(done[path[i]]);
                if (arc.cap < add) {
                    add = arc.cap;
                    cut = i;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
                Edge arc = e[path[i]].get(done[path[i]]);
                arc.cap -= add;
                e[arc.to].get(arc.rev).cap += add;
            }
            len = cut;
            return add;
        }

        int sap() {
            int flow = 0;
            bfs();
            Arrays.fill(done, 0);
            len = 0;
            path[0] = s;
            while (d[s] != n) {
                int u = path[len];
                if (u == t) {
                    flow += augment();
                } else {
                    while (done[u] < e[u].size()) {
                        Edge arc = e[u].get(done[u]);
                        if (d[arc.to] == d[u] - 1 && arc.cap > 0) break;
                        ++done[u];
                    }
                    if (done[u] == e[u].size()) {
                        if (cnt[d[u]] == 1) break;
                        retreat(u);
                        if (u != s) --len;
                    } else {
                        path[++len] = e[u].get(done[u]).to;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (flow == 35) --flow;
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static Network net = new Network();
    static char[][] sci = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static char[][] rec = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] d = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] t = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int X(int i, int j) { return i * MAX + j; }
    static int Y(int i, int j) { return MAX * MAX + i * MAX + j; }
    static int S() { return MAX * MAX * 2; }
    static int T() { return S() + 1; }
    static int N() { return T() + 1; }

    static void bfs(int n) {
        int[] qx = new int[CELLQ];
        int[] qy = new int[CELLQ];
        int head = 0, tail = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                d[i][j] = INF;
                if (sci[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    qx[tail] = i;
                    qy[tail] = j;
                    tail++;
                    d[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        while (head < tail) {
            int x = qx[head];
            int y = qy[head];
            head++;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int xx = x + dx[k];
                int yy = y + dy[k];
                if (0 <= xx && xx < n && 0 <= yy && yy < n
                        && Character.isDigit(sci[xx][yy]) && d[xx][yy] == INF) {
                    d[xx][yy] = d[x][y] + 1;
                    qx[tail] = xx;
                    qy[tail] = yy;
                    tail++;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void gao(int n, int range, int sx, int sy) {
        int[] qx = new int[CELLQ];
        int[] qy = new int[CELLQ];
        int head = 0, tail = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                t[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }
        qx[tail] = sx;
        qy[tail] = sy;
        tail++;
        t[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (head < tail) {
            int x = qx[head];
            int y = qy[head];
            head++;
            if (t[x][y] > range) break;
            if (t[x][y] <= d[x][y] && Character.isDigit(rec[x][y]) && rec[x][y] != '0') {
                net.addEdge(X(sx, sy), Y(x, y), 11);
            }
            if (t[x][y] >= d[x][y]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int xx = x + dx[k];
                int yy = y + dy[k];
                if (0 <= xx && xx < n && 0 <= yy && yy < n
                        && Character.isDigit(sci[xx][yy]) && t[xx][yy] == INF) {
                    t[xx][yy] = t[x][y] + 1;
                    qx[tail] = xx;
                    qy[tail] = yy;
                    tail++;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int range = sc.nextInt();
        net.init(N(), S(), T());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                sci[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (Character.isDigit(sci[i][j]) && sci[i][j] != '0') {
                    net.addEdge(S(), X(i, j), sci[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                rec[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (Character.isDigit(rec[i][j]) && rec[i][j] != '0') {
                    net.addEdge(Y(i, j), T(), rec[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        bfs(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(sci[i][j]) && sci[i][j] != '0') {
                    gao(n, range, i, j);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(net.sap());
        sc.close();
    }
}
